offer.text: The trail leads to the old mineshaft. They must have sheltered down there in the dark — go quickly, before the cold or the creatures find them first. Hurry, I beg you.

accept.text: Take a torch and don't stop. Every moment matters now.

decline.text: Don't give up on them — not when we're this close!

in_progress.text: Are you in the tunnels yet? Time is everything!

ready.text: You went down into the mine? Tell me what you found, quickly!

complete.text: Sheltering in the dark, frightened but whole — you found them. You actually found them. Bless you a thousand times.
